nodes.title: Engineering a Tiny IR and Control-Flow Graph Analyzer
prerequisites: Familiarity with at least one programming language
source_basis: The catalog description says the course begins with abstract syntax trees, control-flow graphs, and intermediate representations.
The catalog identifies Java as the course programming language and emphasizes implementation assignments.
